name: Metergoline
aliases: FI-6337, liserdol, Metergolin, metergoline phenylmethyl ester
summary: Metergoline (INNTooltip INN, BANTooltip British Approved Name), also known as methergoline and sold under the brand names Contralac (veterinary) and Liserdol (clinical), is a monoaminergic medication of the ergoline group which is used as a prolactin inhibitor in the treatment of hyperprolactinemia (high prolactin levels) and to suppress lactation.

pharmacology.text: Metergoline is a ligand of various serotonin and dopamine receptors.

uses.text: Metergoline (INN, BAN), also known as methergoline and sold under the brand names Contralac (veterinary) and Liserdol (clinical), is a monoaminergic medication of the ergoline group which is used as a prolactin inhibitor in the treatment of hyperprolactinemia (high prolactin levels) and to suppress lactation.

sideEffects.en: Reported effects include nausea, stomach upset, dizziness, drowsiness and headache.
sideEffects.zh: 報告的作用包括噁心、腸胃不適、頭暈、嗜睡與頭痛。
sideEffects.zhHans: 报告的作用包括恶心、肠胃不适、头晕、嗜睡与头痛。

fact.en: Metergoline is an ergoline, sharing the ergot ring system of LSD, but it blocks serotonin receptors and is used in dogs, as Contralac, to end false pregnancy.
fact.zh: 甲麥角林屬於麥角靈類，與 LSD 共用麥角環系，但它會阻斷血清素受體，並以 Contralac 之名用於結束犬隻的假懷孕。
fact.zhHans: 甲麦角林属于麦角灵类，与 LSD 共用麦角环系，但它会阻断血清素受体，并以 Contralac 之名用于结束犬只的假怀孕。
